name: SemanticWikiSchema
author: Softwaredesign und Weiterentwicklung des Forks: [https://aufeinwort.info/ Klaus Feldmann / AufEinWort], Programmierung: ChatGPT/Sophos. Basiert auf NeoWiki von [https://professional.wiki/ Professional Wiki], [https://www.entropywins.wtf/mediawiki Jeroen De Dauw], Morne Alberts, [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/User:Alistair3149 Alistair3149] und [https://github.com/ProfessionalWiki/NeoWiki/graphs/contributors?all=1 weiteren Mitwirkenden].

SWSSourceDataMode.description: Defaults to store: refresh all bindings on processing a save and persist results in each Subject. The optional cache mode keeps the previous source resolution and its cache.

WikiSchemaSmwMapping.description: Optional SMW property mappings by schema and URL subobject property names. Empty means schema field names and built-in URL defaults. Reprocess affected pages after changing this setting.

SWSEnableDevelopmentUI.description: Whether development UIs should be enabled

SWSEnableInWikiConfig.description: Whether some SWS settings may also be set on the MediaWiki:SWS JSON configuration page, which requires the editinterface and editsitejson rights to edit; its values take precedence over LocalSettings.php. When false, that page is never given the JSON content model, validated, or read, so only LocalSettings.php applies. See https://github.com/Klaus-Feldmann/SemanticWikiSchema/blob/master/docs/operations/installation.md#on-wiki-settings

SWSEnableLua.description: Whether SWS registers its Lua library (mw.sws) with Scribunto. When false, requiring the library fails like any missing module. The parser functions are unaffected.

SWSEnforceValidation.description: Whether write endpoints reject edits that introduce new error-severity violations. Warnings never block. When false, violations are surfaced in responses but writes always persist.

SWSAutoRenderMainSubject.description: Whether a page's Main Subject is automatically rendered on content pages: as an infobox, or in full on a subject-first wiki.

SWSValidationDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before the subject editor sends a server-side dry-run validation request. 0 disables the timer, so validation only runs on blur or pre-save.

SWSQueryLimits.description: Per-tier per-query resource caps. Keys: 'default' (users without apihighlimits) and 'expensive' (users with apihighlimits). Each value: { timeoutSeconds, maxRows }.

SWSNeo4jInternalWriteUrl.description: Bolt URL SWS uses to write the graph projection to Neo4j.

SWSNeo4jInternalReadUrl.description: Bolt URL SWS uses for read and query traffic against Neo4j; should use a least-privilege Neo4j user.

SWSRdfBaseUri.description: Base URI under which the RDF export mints all SWS IRIs (entity, property, schema, page, etc.). When null, defaults to the wiki's canonical URL ($wgCanonicalServer). Wiki-level on purpose, so sibling projections describe the same entities with identical IRIs.

SWSSubjectFirst.description: Whether this wiki puts Subjects before pages. False by default, which is page-first: a new Subject goes on the page it was created from, and links to Subjects lead to pages. True makes it subject-first: a new Subject gets a page of its own, and links lead to Special:Subject. See https://github.com/Klaus-Feldmann/SemanticWikiSchema/blob/master/docs/operations/installation.md#choosing-page-first-or-subject-first

SWSDataLanguages.description: The languages this wiki's data is in, as BCP 47 language tags, such as [ "de", "fr", "it" ]. The monolingual text editor offers them in this order, with any other language a search away. Empty by default, which stands for the wiki's content language ($wgLanguageCode). See https://github.com/Klaus-Feldmann/SemanticWikiSchema/blob/master/docs/operations/installation.md#data-languages

SWSSubjectPageNamespace.description: The namespace a subject-first wiki creates each Subject's own page in, titled by the Subject ID. The Subject namespace (7480) by default; NS_MAIN (0) puts those pages in the main namespace. Must be a content namespace. Page-first wikis ignore it.

SWSAutoRebuildOnMappingChange.description: Whether saving, deleting or restoring a Mapping page automatically rebuilds, in the background, every configured graph store that holds that Mapping's projection. False by default: such a rebuild reprojects every page on the wiki into that store, which on a large wiki is substantial work an administrator should choose to take on. While it is false, Special:GraphStores reports such a store as stale and offers the rebuild.

SWSSparqlStores.description: SPARQL 1.1 graph stores to keep in sync with page changes and to query, in addition to any Neo4j backend. A list of objects, each with: 'updateUrl' (required, the store's SPARQL 1.1 Update endpoint, e.g. a QLever instance); 'queryUrl' (optional, the store's SPARQL 1.1 Query endpoint the read surfaces use; defaults to 'updateUrl', which is correct for QLever where the two are the same); 'accessToken' (optional, sent as an HTTP Bearer token on both update and query requests, e.g. for a QLever access token or a read-protected endpoint); 'projection' (optional, the RDF vocabulary written to the store: 'native' by default, or any configured Mapping target); and 'name' (optional, what to call this store when rebuilding it, defaulting to the projection, and unique across entries). The query surfaces (the {{#sparql_raw}} parser function, nw.sparqlQuery() in Lua, and POST /sws/v0/query/sparql) target the first configured store. Works with QLever and any SPARQL 1.1 store. Empty by default.

SWSPrefixSearchEnabled.description: Replace the main title search with namespace-scoped suggestions.

SWSPrefixSearchNamespaces.description: Null offers all registered non-negative namespaces. An explicit array replaces the list and determines its order; an empty array disables the global search replacement.

SWSPrefixSearchSubstringFallback.description: Fill remaining suggestion slots with literal case-insensitive title substring matches, for explicitly selected namespaces and at least three characters. Requires working CirrusSearch regex support.

SWSAdditionalSubjectNamespaces.description: Additional namespace IDs supporting Subject data alongside all content namespaces. Applies to every page and subpage, irrespective of the main content model. Virtual namespaces and SWS management namespaces/pages remain excluded.
